init.title: SmplWise Arx: saving automations and the service identity
init.description:
Home Assistant lets only administrators write automations, scenes and scripts. When the first switch is on, the SmplWise Arx add-on may save them for the household members it has granted that permission, for the floors they are limited to. Only content of the simple builder is saved for them; anything advanced still needs an administrator. Off by default; only an administrator can change it, here.

Service identity (optional): the id of ONE Home Assistant user who is NOT an administrator (Settings > People > Users, advanced mode shows the id). SmplWise Arx users who have no Home Assistant account act through it - only device control, the alarm, media, casting and schedules, never automations. Enter the same id in the add-on (Settings > Arx users). Leave empty to refuse every such request.

Runnable items (0.9.4): only the scripts, scenes and automations picked in the last field may be run by Arx-only users, and only in the extended mode. Enter the same list in the add-on (Settings > Arx users). Empty by default - nothing runs.

Residual risk - the entity policy: for Arx-only users this bridge also checks the service user's own Home Assistant entity policy for every device a call or a runnable item targets. That check protects only when an administrator restricted the service user (a group whose entity policy names only the devices Arx may reach). A regular user without such a group may control every entity, so the fence then adds nothing. Restrict the service user before the extended mode is ever turned on. Since 0.9.6 the extended mode refuses every extended action while the service user is not restricted this way.

data.delegated_authoring: Let Arx save automations, scenes and scripts for users who are not administrators - simple-builder content only
data.service_user_id: Service identity: Home Assistant user id (not an administrator)
data.local_identity_extended: Extended mode for Arx-only users: doors, alarm zone bypass, scripts and scenes, live camera source (under each user's Arx permission; a security review is required before turning it on)
data.local_identity_runnable: Scripts, scenes and automations Arx-only users may run (pick from the list; none picked = none). Each run is also checked here: an item whose steps open a lock, disarm, arm with bypass, call a service outside the everyday device controls or target a device the service user may not control is refused.

config_item.name: Config item (SMPLWISE add-on only)
config_item.description: Signed write to, or run of, one automation, script or scene on behalf of a VMS user. Not meant to be called from automations.

schedule.name: Schedule (SMPLWISE add-on only)
schedule.description: Signed write to the Scheduler component on behalf of a VMS user. Not meant to be called from automations.

stream_source.name: Stream source (SMPLWISE add-on only)
stream_source.description: Read-only, signed: the stream source of one camera entity, for the SMPLWISE add-on. Not meant to be called from automations.

cast_stream.name: Cast a camera to a screen (SMPLWISE add-on only)
cast_stream.description: Signed: plays the SMPLWISE add-on's cast-relay address on one Google Cast media player, stops it or switches it off. Not meant to be called from automations.

lease_event.name: Capture lease event (SMPLWISE add-on only)
lease_event.description: Signed: one message of the capture lease's revocation stream, checked and handed to the WisKey consumer. Not meant to be called from automations.

lease_request.name: Capture lease request (SMPLWISE add-on only)
lease_request.description: Signed: one request of the capture lease, checked and handed to the WisKey consumer. Not meant to be called from automations.
